# webtables/fn

> Function definition: a WebAssembly function of no parameters returning an `i64`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/fn.pkg) · translates [std/fn](../std/fn.md)

The arguments are on the memory stack, pushed by the caller as in
bintables. `$__pk_enter` sets the frame pointer `$fp` and reserves
`{frame}` bytes for locals; `$top` is where the stack pointer goes back
to on return, which also pops the arguments. Falling off the end returns
0.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(func ${name.label} (result i64) (local $fp i32) (local $top i32) (local $ret i64)
(local.set $top (i32.add (global.get $sp) (i32.const {params.stack})))
(local.set $fp (call $__pk_enter (i32.const {frame})))
{body}
(global.set $sp (local.get $top))
(i64.const 0))
```
